answer.rationale: The temporal signature matches memory_b1 exactly: degradation within 2 hours of release, elevated write-path latency, prior build known stable. Rollback is the fastest path to restore the known-good state without risking write loss. We verify memory_b1 to confirm rollback success profile and memory_b2 to confirm why failover is contraindicated here (hot writes during settlement peak). Circuit breakers and read replicas don't address causation; capacity add is too slow under current load. Rollback preserves all writes because it operates on the compute path, not replication.
